## 6. The residual of the AR(1)-substituted estimate: the finite-sample null, the cross-lag deviation and its budget, the directed and aligned statistics, and the split-half test

**Where the estimate does not exist (B26).** A window's measured (a_x, a_y, q) are those of a pair of AR(1) processes only if the AR(1)-substituted matrix is positive definite, that is, if |q| < 1 and (1 − a_x²)(1 − a_y²) > q²(1 − a_x a_y)²; where it is not, no AR(1) pair has them and the estimate does not exist. The code before the correction of 29 September 2026 took the logarithm of the absolute value of each block determinant and so still returned sixteen numbers for such a matrix, which entered the means (record, "The matrices that are not positive definite (B26): pre-run entry"). Every mean of the estimate, and of any quantity built on a substituted matrix, is now over the pair-windows, pairs or draws where it exists: the residual is the observed mean over all of them minus the substituted mean over those; a correlation of observed and substituted values is over the pairs where both exist; a response to the cross-lag departures is over the pairs whose four matrices are positive definite; and in the simulations whose per-pair values are means over 14 windows a pair is left out of a quantity whose matrix fails in one of its windows (S18 Table's brackets). On the data the estimate does not exist in 4 of the 2,569,560 pair-windows at W = 60 on each variant, in 1,617 (`ts_gsr`) and 1,661 (`ts_demean`) of the 5,139,120 at W = 30, and in none of the 183,540 whole-run pairs of either variant (`notes/review_results/partB/diag_tables.md`; `positive_definite_tables.md`, B26); on the AR(p)-whitened series of section 8 it does not exist in 10,817 (`ts_gsr`) and 15,776 (`ts_demean`) of their 2,569,560 pair-windows each. Leaving out the W = 60 pair-windows (four on each variant) moves three numbers of the main text at their printed precision, which the main text states where it quotes them: on `ts_gsr` the substituted TDMI DiD of Table 1 (−0.1129 to −0.1130) and the exact p of the residual DiD against +0.0049 (0.219 to 0.218; Results 4), and on `ts_demean` the cross-half correlation r(res_even, ac_odd) (−0.052 to −0.051; Results 4); at W = 30 values of S12 Table move in their last digit, among them the substituted level and the residual DiD on `ts_gsr` (1.1062 to 1.1061, +0.0182 to +0.0183).

The cortical parcels are the 100-parcel, seven-network resolution of the multiresolution parcellations released with Schaefer et al. (2018); this repository holds its parcel names (`data/Schaefer2018_100Parcels_7Networks_order.lut`, copied from that release), which `scripts/11_regional_analysis.py` checks against `sch116_to_yeo.csv`. The released files are pseudonymised: the quantities used carry no demographic, image or identifying field.
why: the claim-by-claim check of 29–30 September 2026: Singleton et al.'s list of released data does not include framewise displacement, and they do not call the data pseudonymised; the files the analysis reads, the run layout and the two variants are stated here from the files themselves
